// @vitest-environment node
import pg from "pg";
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { expect, it } from "vitest";
import { assertDisposableProofUrl } from "../scripts/run-required-db-proofs.mjs";
import { stageSensitiveDemoSeed } from "./fixtures/retired-pre-bot/scripts/sensitive-demo-seed.mjs";
import { sensitiveKeyring } from "../api/_lib/sensitiveDataCrypto.js";
import { revealRow } from "../api/_lib/sensitiveContent.js";

const databaseIt = process.env.RUN_DEMO_CASEWORK_DB_TESTS === "1" ? it : it.skip;
databaseIt("encrypts both real SAMPLE seed functions in both lanes and rejects their former plaintext writers", async () => {
  const client = new pg.Client({ connectionString: assertDisposableProofUrl(process.env.SUPABASE_DB_URL) });
  const ring = sensitiveKeyring("demo", { SAMPLE_SENSITIVE_DATA_KEYS: JSON.stringify({ proof: randomBytes(32).toString("base64") }), SAMPLE_SENSITIVE_DATA_ACTIVE_KEY: "proof" });
  const adapter = { rpc: async (name, args) => {
    const calls = {
      sensitive_demo_seed_plan: ["select public.sensitive_demo_seed_plan($1,$2) data", [args.p_lane, args.p_run_id]],
      stage_sensitive_write: ["select public.stage_sensitive_write($1,$2,$3,$4) data", [args.p_actor, args.p_operation, args.p_arguments, args.p_envelopes]],
    };
    const [sql, values] = calls[name];
    return { data: (await client.query(sql, values)).rows[0].data };
  } };
  await client.connect();
  try {
    await client.query("begin");
    await client.query(`select set_config('request.jwt.claims','{"role":"service_role"}',true)`);
    for (const lane of ["presg", "uniondemo"]) {
      const run = (await client.query(`select id from private.${lane === "presg" ? "presg_demo" : "uniondemo"}_runs where state in ('applied','verified') order by updated_at desc limit 1`)).rows[0]?.id;
      expect(run, `${lane} base lane must already be applied`).toBeTruthy();
      // Only the existing deterministic case coordinates are prerequisites;
      // unrelated aggregate seed gates are exercised by the parity lifecycle test.
      await client.query(`insert into public.member_cases(id,user_id,reference,title,case_type)
        select private.member_stress_uuid($1::text || ':parity:case:' || n),
          private.demo_seed_user($2,$1::uuid,n+2),upper($2) || '-ENC-' || n,
          'Synthetic encrypted seed prerequisite','other'
        from generate_series(1,120) n on conflict(id) do nothing`, [run, lane]);
      await stageSensitiveDemoSeed(adapter, lane, run, ring);
      for (const name of ["demo_seed_apply_member_support", "demo_seed_apply_casework"]) {
        const result = await client.query(`select private.${name}($1,$2) data`, [lane, run]);
        expect(result.rows[0].data.ok, `${lane}/${name}`).toBe(true);
      }
      const plan = (await adapter.rpc("sensitive_demo_seed_plan", { p_lane: lane, p_run_id: run })).data;
      for (const table of ["member_accommodation_requests", "casework_retaliation_reports", "casework_retaliation_patterns"]) {
        const rows = (await client.query(`select * from public.${table} where organization_id=$1`, [plan[0].organization])).rows;
        expect(rows.length, `${lane}/${table}`).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        for (const row of rows) {
          const fixture = plan.find(item => item.purpose === table && item.record === row.id);
          expect(fixture).toBeDefined();
          const opened = revealRow(table, row, ring);
          for (const [field, value] of Object.entries(fixture.fields)) {
            expect(row[field]).toBe("[encrypted]");
            expect(opened[field]).toBe(value);
          }
        }
      }
      for (const [migration, name] of [["20260829030000_member_support_programs.sql", "demo_seed_apply_member_support"], ["20260830050000_demo_seed_casework_completion.sql", "demo_seed_apply_casework"]]) {
        const source = readFileSync(new URL(`../supabase/migrations/${migration}`, import.meta.url), "utf8");
        const start = source.indexOf(`create function private.${name}(`);
        const end = source.indexOf("$function$;", start) + "$function$;".length;
        expect(start).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        await client.query("savepoint old_seed");
        await client.query(source.slice(start, end).replace("create function", "create or replace function"));
        await expect(client.query(`select private.${name}($1,$2)`, [lane, run])).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "22023" });
        await client.query("rollback to savepoint old_seed");
      }
      await stageSensitiveDemoSeed(adapter, lane, run, ring);
      for (const name of ["demo_seed_apply_member_support", "demo_seed_apply_casework"]) {
        expect((await client.query(`select private.${name}($1,$2) data`, [lane, run])).rows[0].data.ok).toBe(true);
      }
    }
  } finally { await client.query("rollback"); await client.end(); }
}, 60000);
